newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kohl told Yeltsin no NATO expansion in 1996 - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Kohl told Yeltsin no NATO expansion in 1996 - Tass.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl told Russian President Boris Yeltsin on Saturday that no decision on the enlargement of NATO to the east would be taken this year, Itar-Tass news agency said, quoting an unnamed source.
"In 1996, no decisions on the enlargement of NATO to the east will be taken," Tass said, saying its source was close to those present at talks on Saturday between Kohl and Yeltsin.

The source said the question of extending the Western defence alliance to former communist countries in eastern Europe, which Moscow opposes, had been a major topic of the discussion at the Rus hunting lodge near Moscow.

"The parties agreed that a decision on enlarging NATO to the east would be taken subject to the development of relations between Russia and the North Atlantic alliance," Tass quoted the source as saying.
